name: print-social-pink-cutout-hug-post-with-white-outline-and-ring
title: Hot-pink post with a greyscale embrace cutout, giant white caps, script and bouquet and ring stickers
whatItIs: A hot-pink portrait post with a black-and-white photo of two people hugging cut out with a thick white outline, a flourished script 'Це', a tilted pink label 'НЕ', giant white extended 'ЛЮБОВ', a pink brush underline, white spark lines, a colour bouquet and a ring box sticker and a handle pill.
whatItMeans: Emotional and punchy; mono photo plus hot pink and colour props tell a story.
techniques: Outline a mono cutout in thick white.
Stack script, label and giant caps.
Add colour object stickers (bouquet, ring) as punchlines.
Use spark strokes and brush underline.

vocabulary.definition: A thick white border around a cutout.
Script, label and giant caps combined.
A rough painted stroke under text.
